records.title: The Bedroom
records.altText: Painting of bedroom, blue walls, green window, tan bed, red bedding.

records.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
records.altText: Large painting of people in a crowded park, brushstrokes are dots.

records.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as The Great Wave, from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjurokkei)"
records.artistDisplay:
Katsushika Hokusai 葛飾 北斎
Japanese, 1760-1849
records.altText: A color woodblock print of a large crashing wave, looms over two narrow boats full of people. Mt Fuji in the background.  There is a faint peach colored sky.

records.title: Stacks of Wheat (End of Summer)
records.altText: Painting composed of short, dense brushstrokes depicts two domed stacks of wheat that cast long shadows on a field. The angled light indicates either a rising or setting sun.

records.title: Water Lilies
records.altText: Painting of a pond seen up close spotted with thickly painted pink and white water lilies and a shadow across the top third of the picture.

records.title: Two Sisters (On the Terrace)
records.altText: Impressionist painting of two girls on balcony, bright flower hat, knitting basket.

records.title: Self-Portrait
records.altText: Painting of a red-haired, bearded man with light skin, painted in short brushstrokes and multicolored dots. The background is likewise a mass of small, closely spaced colored dots, these in green, blue, and red-orange.

records.title: The Child's Bath
records.altText: Painting of mother in blue, purple, and green-stripped dress washing child's feet.

records.title: Arrival of the Normandy Train, Gare Saint-Lazare
records.altText: Loosely painted image of an open-air train station. On the right, a parked train gives off an enormous plumb of white smoke, making the scene look as though it were full of clouds. A huddled mass of barely discernible people crowd around the train on both sides of the tracks. Blue, green, and gray tones dominate.

records.title: The Basket of Apples
records.altText: Painting of a basket of green and red-yellow apples spilling over into a white cloth placed on a wooden table, with a dark green bottle and a plate of pale biscuits behind.

records.title: Distant View of Niagara Falls
records.altText: Painting of a vast autumn scene with two very small figures in Indigenous clothing standing on a cliff overlooking a massive waterfall in the distance.

records.title: The Beach at Sainte-Adresse
records.altText: Painting of a beach on a cloudy day with several sailboats on the water, a few rowboats on the shore, and two groupings of people on the sand.

records.title: The Herring Net
records.altText: Painting of two fishermen in small wooden boat on rocky seas.

records.title: The Girl by the Window
records.altText: Loosely painted scene of a brown-haired girl in her nightgown standing in a dark room, gazing out a window into a brighter night, her face unseen and her hand drawing back the pale curtain. Light blues and pink whites dominate the girl and the window, while deep browns, blues, and greens color the darkened portions of her room.

records.title: The Bay of Marseille, Seen from L'Estaque
records.altText: Impressionist sea landscape, tan houses, blue ocean, distant mountains.

records.title: The Watermill with the Great Red Roof
records.altText: Landscape painting featuring a wavy tree tree in the foreground and a watermill with a red roof adjacent to a river at right. Colors are subdued earth tones, the foliage a dark green and the river a muddy brown. Water flows through the mill wheel under a cloudy sky of gray and blue. Three individuals can be seen in the distance at left.

records.title: Ballet at the Paris Opéra
records.altText: Color pastel drawing of ballerinas in tutus on stage, watched by audience.

records.title: The Fountain, Villa Torlonia, Frascati, Italy
records.altText: Portrait of a woman in white with a bonnet perched on an architectural feature painting something to her right, a spouting water fountain, greenery, and a an ornate, low white fence behind her. Beside her, a man leans back, eying the canvas.

records.title: Lozenge Composition with Yellow, Black, Blue, Red, and Gray
records.altText: A square white tile, rotated 90 degrees, crossed by black lines intersecting at 90-degree angles. A few of the shapes thus formed—some partial squares, some rectangles—are colored in a single shade of yellow, blue, black, or red.

records.title: Nocturne: Blue and Gold—Southampton Water
records.altText: A sparsely painted waterside scene in dark tones with minimal ghostly shapes suggesting ships, yellow glitches of paint for light reflections, and the orb of an orange moon overhead.

records.title: Landscape with Saint John on Patmos

records.title: Fishing Boats with Hucksters Bargaining for Fish
